title: UBO Creathon Participation
description: Developed a smart pill dispenser prototype during the UBO Creathon using an ESP32, RTC, LCD, stepper motor, and a mobile application.

title: Line-Following Robot Competition
description: Collaborated with GEII students on the development of a line-following robot using a Raspberry Pi Pico, infrared sensors, trajectory testing, and technical documentation.

title: Global Industrie Paris Exhibition
description: Visited the Global Industrie exhibition in Paris to explore innovative industrial technologies and connect with international companies and startups.

title: European Defense Tech Hackathon 2025
description: Presented a project focused on FPV drone detection and tracking using cameras and artificial intelligence, based on computer vision techniques.

title: European Defense Tech Hub Event
description: Participated in a technology event bringing together students, experts, and innovators to explore drones, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and emerging technologies.

title: FPV Drone Hands-On Workshop
description: Completed a practical workshop on FPV drone assembly, embedded electronics, structural design, and flight control principles.

title: Inside the OCP Control Room
description: During my internship at OCP SA, I gained hands-on exposure to industrial control systems and supervision technologies. This experience allowed me to discover SCADA interfaces, process monitoring, industrial instrumentation, and control-command systems used in large-scale phosphate production facilities.

title: Industrial Automation Internship at OCP SA
description: One month of immersive experience in industrial automation, electrical systems, and instrumentation. Working alongside engineers, I explored the technologies that ensure the monitoring, safety, and reliability of industrial processes.
